title: Localize MonthlyActivitySliverCalendar's hardcoded English strings
rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings; AppLocalizations/ARB with ICU plurals)

evidence.quote: return const Center(child: Text('No activity data'));

why: Every other widget in this EN/HE batch routes text through AppLocalizations, but this file hand-rolls English-only pluralization with a raw ternary. It's currently unreachable (see the companion dead-code finding) so no Hebrew user sees it today — but if anyone wires this widget into a screen without noticing, it ships untranslated text into the Hebrew build silently, since no grep in this repo's audit checks widget files for bare Text('literal') calls.
recommendation: If the widget is kept, replace the three literals with AppLocalizations getters and ICU plural messages before it is ever attached to a route.
acceptance_criteria: No bare string literal is passed to Text(...) in this file; make arb-parity stays green after adding the new keys.
